priorities.summary: An improper validation of the specified type of input in Axis Camera Station Pro and Axis Camera Station 5 could allow an attacker to compromise the system. Axis rates it critical; affected versions are Camera Station Pro below 6.17 and Camera Station 5 below 5.59 SR2.

SAP NetWeaver lacks necessary authorization checks and sufficient input validation in certain remote-enabled functionality. A low-privileged attacker could send specially crafted input through a remote interface to inject and execute code.

SAP NetWeaver Knowledge Management (XML Forms) does not sufficiently restrict the selection of XSL transformations it processes. Under certain conditions, an authenticated user with access to the affected functionality could inject and execute code.

model.name: Google DeepMind AlphaGenome 2
model.summary: Google DeepMind's next-generation DNA model predicts how genetic variants change gene activity in specific human cell types and states, rather than tissue averages. Trained on more than 107 million cell profiles, it identifies nearly twice as many causal variants as the original AlphaGenome, and is available now for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API.
